t.zh: <level-ref to="def-max"></level-ref>里 max 的两行都带条件。带条件的规则改写一处以后，条件成为新目标，排在后面；证出它，这次改写才算成立。
t.en: Both rows of max in <level-ref to="def-max"></level-ref> carry a condition. Once a rule with a condition rewrites a place, the condition becomes a new goal, queued behind; only when it is proved does the rewrite stand.

after.zh: Isabelle 的化简器把这类规则叫作条件改写规则。
after.en: Isabelle’s simplifier calls such rules conditional rewrite rules.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 事先不知道该用 max 的哪一条规则：两条都试。
hint.en: Which rule for max applies is not known in advance: try both.

hint.zh: 条件证不出的那条路，会自行失败。
hint.en: The way whose condition cannot be proved fails by itself.
